messages:
IncidentBot: ALERT: sustained increase in 5xx and stream disconnects on runtime-prod starting 03:12 UTC. Paging oncall.

maria (oncall): I'm on it. Seeing increased disconnects/503s from router -> worker-pool; many of these coincide with long-lived streaming sessions (clients sending large context repeatedly).

tina (eng-runtime): quick look at metrics: worker heap churn high, GC pauses spike at 03:14, and a few OOM restarts on worker instances. KV cache miss rate up 4x for hot prefixes.

kevin (night-sre): immediate mitigations I'm proposing and applying now:
- short-circuit long-streaming requests > 60s to fallback-model-small
- apply temporary tenant burst caps: per-key burst 20 req / 60s for unauthenticated traffic
- disable per-request heavy eval hooks for 15m

Commands executed:
```
redwoodctl routes set --from runtime-prod --to fallback-model-small --when "streaming=true and duration>60s"
redwoodctl quotas patch --selector public=true --burst=20 --window=60s
redwoodctl feature toggle --name heavy-evals --off --duration 15m
```

maria (oncall): also flipping a mitigation header so SDKs and customers get structured info when they receive throttles/failures.
Headers we'll return on mitigation responses:
- `X-Redwood-Mitigation: true`
- `Retry-After: <seconds>` when rate-limited
- body includes `mitigation_id` and `mitigation_type` fields

alice (devex): drafting SDK advisory now. Key guidance we'll push to clients:
- Use decorrelated jitter backoff (recommended) rather than simple exponential backoff for streaming retries.
- Default retry limits: streaming clients -> max 2 retries; non-streaming generation -> max 4 retries.
- Always respect `Retry-After` header if present (server-suggested wait > backoff delay should be used).
- Support an `Idempotency-Key` header and persist it across retries until final success or explicit cancellation.
- Provide a programmatic hook to fall back to non-streaming call if stream disconnects with partial content (so app-level state can resume safely).

alice (devex): sample JS backoff snippet (decorrelated jitter):
```
// decorrelated jitter backoff
const base = 100; // ms
let sleep = base;
for (let attempt = 0; attempt < maxRetries; attempt++) {
  const jitter = Math.random() * sleep;
  await sleepMs(jitter);
  const res = await apiCall();
  if (res.ok) return res;
  sleep = Math.min(maxDelay, base + Math.random() * (sleep * 3));
}
```

alice (devex): curl + idempotency example:
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -d '{"input":"..."}'
```

tina (eng-runtime): note for engineers: platform will tag dropped/short-circuited streams with `mitigation_id` which will be present in logs; saves correlating client reports.

kevin (night-sre): immediate observed impact after routing + caps:
- 5xx rate dropped from ~7.1% -> 1.8% in 6m
- p95 latency reduced by ~45%
- a few worker restarts still observed but rate decreasing

maria (oncall): customer impact: CS reports ~5 customers affected; 2 had streaming interruptions but received retries. Billing flagged for investigation (we will credit if duplicate generation occurred due to client retries). Bob from CS taking lead.

bob (cs): contacting impacted customers now with templated note. Template includes:
- short summary of incident and mitigation
- action for customers (rotate idempotency usage: include tokens on retries)
- expected follow-up and credits if duplicated billable units found

kevin (night-sre): handoff to morning SRE in 2 hours. Handoff checklist I'm leaving:
- mitigation flags: fallback-model-small active
- tenant caps: unauthenticated burst caps in place
- heavy-evals: disabled until 03:30 UTC
- mitigation_id: INC-20260315-29 (include in all logs and notifications)
- postmortem owner: kevin

maria (oncall): adding action items for postmortem and engineering follow-ups:
- eng-runtime: investigate KV-cache prewarm and GC tuning for worker-templates (tina)
- devex: update SDK defaults to include decorrelated jitter and idempotency examples (alice)
- product: evaluate tenant-aware burst protection productization (sam)
- cs: confirm communications and credit policy for duplicates (bob)

alice (devex): will publish an SDK advisory PR and mark it `urgent` in repos. Plan:
1) draft advisory + code snippets (30m)
2) push language-specific helper functions (`withIdempotency`, `decorrelatedBackoff`) (2h)
3) staged release to package registries (4h)

kevin (night-sre): monitoring notes and next steps: continue to monitor worker OOMs, if restarts persist we'll scale up worker pool and enable evict-on-large-payloads for unauthenticated traffic. Rollback plan: remove fallback routing and tenant caps once 5xx < 0.5% for 30m.

tina (eng-runtime): logs of note:
```
[03:14:02] worker-9: GC pause 120ms -> increased latency
[03:15:10] router: short-circuited streaming session id=abcd-1234, mitigation_id=INC-20260315-29
[03:16:40] worker-22: restarted (OOM)
```

IncidentBot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied, partial recovery. Assigned INC-20260315-29. Continuing to track.

maria (oncall): closing thread for now; leaving monitoring open and handing to kevin. Add any follow-ups to INC-20260315-29.

kevin (night-sre): taking it. I'll post a rollback/restore note once we hit stable thresholds. Thanks all.
